all 21 programs selected by v1.7.19 tests/CMakeLists.txt, including private helpers embedded through common.h, are additionally compiled as measured test translation units and linked from those installed objects; no assertions or includes are rewritten; Unity alone is reference-built and excluded from the subject population

the full Unity selection uses explicit -std=c89 -O2 commands beside the release Makefile build, not a claim to reproduce CMake's optional sanitizer/Valgrind configurations; tests run from the original tests directory so the original inputs and json-patch-tests are consumed

adjustments.buildCommand:
(set -e
make
(
set -e
mkdir -p tests/evocc-full
printf '%s\n' "${CC:-gcc-14} -std=c89 -O2 -c tests/unity/src/unity.c -o tests/evocc-full/unity.o"
"${CC:-gcc-14}" -std=c89 -O2 -c tests/unity/src/unity.c -o tests/evocc-full/unity.o
for test in parse_examples parse_number parse_hex4 parse_string parse_array parse_object parse_value print_string print_number print_array print_object print_value misc_tests parse_with_opts compare_tests cjson_add readme_examples minify_tests json_patch_tests old_utils_tests misc_utils_tests; do
  printf '%s\n' "${CC:-gcc-14} -std=c89 -O2 -c tests/$test.c -o tests/evocc-full/$test.o"
  "${CC:-gcc-14}" -std=c89 -O2 -c tests/$test.c -o tests/evocc-full/$test.o
done
)
(
set -e
# Rebuild archives even when restored objects have equal/coarse timestamps.
# The independently audited object bytes, not a previous trial's archive, must
# reach every public/private test executable.
rm -f cJSON_test libcjson.a libcjson_utils.a
make 'CJSON_TEST_SRC=test.c cJSON.o' static tests
for test in cjson_add compare_tests minify_tests old_utils_tests misc_utils_tests; do
  "${CC:-gcc-14}" -DCJSON_TESTS_COMMON_H -include ./cJSON.h -include stdbool.h -include string.h tests/$test.c tests/unity/src/unity.c cJSON.o cJSON_Utils.o -lm -o tests/$test
done
for test in parse_examples parse_number parse_hex4 parse_string parse_array parse_object parse_value print_string print_number print_array print_object print_value misc_tests parse_with_opts compare_tests cjson_add readme_examples minify_tests json_patch_tests old_utils_tests misc_utils_tests; do
  "${CC:-gcc-14}" tests/evocc-full/$test.o tests/evocc-full/unity.o libcjson_utils.a libcjson.a -lm -o tests/evocc-full/$test
done
)
)
